Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.

Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Anointer Priest trigger.

141-3125-3967.description:

Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.

Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Victimize
Resolve the Victimize copy, sacrificing a creature and returning Naru Meha and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Stormbound Geist

Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Stormbound Geist
When Stormbound Geist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.

1322-3259-4053-7604.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control with mana value 3 or less.
You either control another nontoken creature with mana value 3 or less, or have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1322-3259-4053-7604.description:
Declare Excava and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Excava triggers, returning up to one creature with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to another creature with mana value 3 or less, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
1322-3259-4053-7604.notes: If both creatures used have haste, you can ignore the haste enabler.

413-2086-6996.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Kitchen Finks trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1987-3227-7089.notablePrerequisites: You control three permanents that enter untapped and that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.

Holding priority, activate three permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.

Fire Lord Azula triggers, copying Ghostly Flicker, targeting two other mana-producing permanents
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking the two targeted permanents.
Resolve the original Ghostly Flicker, blinking the targeted permanent and Scrivener.
When Scrivener enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.

Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Willow Geist.
When Willow Geist dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Willow Geist from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Willow Geist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life

Repeat.

1193-2743-6669.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase. Summon: G.F. Cerberus triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its third chapter ability, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast twice.
Cast Mythos of Illuna by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Summon: G.F. Cerberus triggers, copying Mythos of Illuna twice, with the copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Mythos of Illunas, copying Biovisionary three times.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

856-2279-2921-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.

Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2981-4493-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
You have enough mana to cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication
2981-4493-5365.description:
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Lonis that isn't legendary.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat from step 2.
2981-4493-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

1753-4053-5499--6.notablePrerequisites: The creature with undying does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.

Repeat.

Repeat from step 2.

Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard by paying {B}, attaching it to Lurrus of the Dream-Den.
Repeat.

2034-4690-4790.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two basic lands.

If you control three or more basic lands, this combo nets infinite colorless mana and creature tokens.

Cast Dargo by paying {R} and sacrificing Ruthless Technomancer.
When Ruthless Technomancer dies, Cemetery Puca triggers, choose not to pay.
Repeat from step 8.

Activate Instill Energy by paying {0}, untapping Sanctum Weaver.
Cast Minimus Containment from exile by paying {2}{W}, attaching it to Instill Energy, causing it to become a Treasure artifact.
Repeat from step 4.

Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Festering Newt on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bogbrew Witch trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.
